# SentinelOps

> Public research website for the SentinelOps verification programme, including its Provability Fabric work on specifications, evidence, runtime mediation, and independent evaluation.

Canonical website: https://sentinelops.world/
Source repositories: https://github.com/orgs/SentinelOps-CI/repositories

The site contains research descriptions and programme objectives. A claim about a particular system is supported only to the extent established by the relevant public implementation, verification artifacts, and evaluation record. The website itself is not evidence of universal safety guarantees.

## Core site

- [Home](https://sentinelops.world/): Overview of the research programme and execution-verification objectives.
- [Products](https://sentinelops.world/products): Published tools and repository links.
- [Mission](https://sentinelops.world/mission): Research objectives and programme direction.
- [Documentation](https://sentinelops.world/docs): Entry points to repository-maintained technical documentation.
- [Writing](https://sentinelops.world/blog): Research notes and PDF documents.
- [Contact](https://sentinelops.world/contact): Public correspondence channels.

## Machine-readable discovery

- [Research index (JSON)](https://sentinelops.world/research-index.json): Canonical article records, declared dates, and source file links.
- [Atom feed](https://sentinelops.world/feed.xml): Publication updates with canonical article links.
- [XML sitemap](https://sentinelops.world/sitemap.xml)
- [Robots directives](https://sentinelops.world/robots.txt)

Research notes and implementation repositories have different evidentiary roles. For implementation status and test results, consult the linked repository directly.
